subject.why: The retro pastel-yellow washing machine is instantly recognizable and features the requested round glass door and soap bubbles.

category.why: The washing machine sits on a stylized tiled floor with a smooth concentric orange gradient wall behind it, strictly following category 3.

clean.why: There are no text, UI elements, watermarks, characters, or borders.

framing.why: The object and floating bubbles are well-centered with ample, comfortable margins on all sides.

colour.why: The palette is bright and warm, with the yellow machine popping distinctly against the orange wall and blue/white floor.

detail.why: Details are kept chunky and stylized without noisy micro-textures or extraneous props.

style.why: Rendered with smooth, rounded volumes and soft satin lighting that matches the reference cards.
